appearance_facts.fact: A single blue line connects black circular markers across the plot area, descending from the upper-left to the lower-right.
The first marker is the highest point on the line, with a label directly above it.
The final marker is the lowest point on the line, with a label to its upper-right.
Each yearly data point is marked by a small black circle and has a numeric annotation in degrees Celsius.
The line shows a continuous downward slope with no upward segments.
The vertical axis runs from 0 at the bottom to above 20 at the top, with tick labels at 0, 5, 10, 15, 20.
The horizontal axis spans 2005 to 2015 with yearly tick labels.
The chart title 'Global Temperature Change' appears in large bold text.
